_about: Made-up example of the Workbench team settings. Copy it (or the .yaml twin, if your PCs have PyYAML) to .devin/rules/ in your repo and put your own values in.

jira.queries_note: Ticket lists the Workbench reads. {user} is the person's Jira username. qa and uat must match the QA and UAT queues in .devin/rules/dashboard-roles.yaml; waiting finds the Approval and Question sub-tasks assigned to the person.

queries.sprint: project = ACME AND "IT Team" = "Acme-Claims-Web" AND sprint in openSprints() AND issuetype in (Story, Bug, Task) ORDER BY rank ASC
queries.open: project = ACME AND "IT Team" = "Acme-Claims-Web" AND resolution = Unresolved AND issuetype in (Story, Bug, Task) ORDER BY updated DESC
queries.mine: project = ACME AND assignee = "{user}" AND resolution = Unresolved ORDER BY updated DESC
queries.mine_sprint: project = ACME AND assignee = "{user}" AND sprint in openSprints() ORDER BY rank ASC
queries.qa: project = ACME AND status in ({statuses.qa}) AND resolution = Unresolved ORDER BY status ASC, updated ASC
queries.uat: project = ACME AND status in ({statuses.uat}) AND resolution = Unresolved ORDER BY status ASC, updated ASC
queries.waiting: project = ACME AND labels in (Approval, Question) AND assignee = "{user}" AND resolution = Unresolved ORDER BY created ASC

jira.statuses_note: Jira statuses per queue. JQL in jira.queries and .devin/rules/dashboard-roles.yaml says {statuses.qa} and gets the list filled in, so a renamed status is one edit here.
jira.phases_note: Phase suffix of a story summary (' - DEV') and prefix of a sub-task ('DEV- ...'), in delivery order.

workflow._note: Environments in promotion order (in_order: false keeps one out of the order). app_branch and deploy_branch are the branches in the app and deploy repos, values the suffix of values-<env>.yaml / tekton-values-<env>.yaml, gate the approval needed before promoting into it, tag_branch where the pipeline writes the image tag when a person has to merge it, verified: false refuses the environment until the mapping is confirmed. Used by promote_check.py and /promote.

docs._note: Repo-relative paths of the documents people are pointed at. Move a document, change its path here.

act_as._note: Jira usernames of the people who may switch the Workbench to someone else (Me > Who you are) and use "su - <name>" in a Devin session. Hidden from everyone else.
